The explicit CDF/FTC proof, positive finite subprobability, Borel marked law and triple integrability are attributed ASTIS completion; no full path-law/invariance/main claim.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ satisfy α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix arbitrary y,r∈E and z=(x,p)∈E×E. Define c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_s(z)=(c+cos(s)(x−c)+√η sin(s)p, −sin(s)(x−c)/√η+cos(s)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), and λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}. Total real division makes S_r the identity when g_r(x)=0. For t≥0 set Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ, P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1), ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0}, and U(sample)=τ_z(ε_0(sample)). Thus the authors first threshold is canonical coordinate0, not a supplied clock or law. Set F(sample)=untopD_0(U(sample)), viewed as a real number; it is the finite waiting time when U is finite and zero at infinity. For every finite T≥0 define A_T={sample:0<U(sample)≤T}, d_z(s)=λ_r(Φ_s(z))exp(−Λ_z(max{s,0})), ρ_T=(Lebesgue restricted to (0,T]).withDensity(ofReal(d_z)), and J_z(s)=(max{s,0},S_r(Φ_s(z)))∈[0,∞)×(E×E), for all real s. Moreover ρ_T is a finite subprobability measure, ρ_T(ℝ)=1−exp(−Λ_z(T))≤1. expMeasure 1 is the rate-one exponential measure on the real line. infinitePi is the canonical countable product on all real sequences. toNNReal is max(x,0) as a nonnegative real. WithTop NNReal includes infinity; untopD 0 returns the finite value when finite and zero at infinity.

hittingAfter f C 0 a is the infimum of nonnegative times when f(t)(a) belongs to C, with infinity for an empty hit set. Real division is total, with division by zero equal to zero. Products associate to the right.

Measure.restrict keeps the indicated event without dividing by its mass. Measure.map is measurable pushforward. volume is Lebesgue measure on the real line; withDensity weights a measure by an extended nonnegative density. ENNReal.ofReal is max(x,0) represented as an extended nonnegative real.

Measure.real evaluates measure and converts its mass to a real number; IsFiniteMeasure asserts finite total mass.       Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let U : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ) → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z sample => τ y xRef z (ε sample 0)
    let F : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun y xRef z sample => ((U y xRef z sample).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0)
    let A : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → Set (ℕ → ℝ) :=
      fun y xRef z T => {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U y xRef z sample ∧
        U y xRef z sample ≤ (T : WithTop ℝ≥0)}
    let d : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ → ℝ := fun y xRef z s =>
      rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z) * Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z (Real.toNNReal s))
    let ρ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → Measure ℝ := fun y xRef z T =>
      (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ))).withDensity
        (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (d y xRef z s))
    let J : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ → (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) :=
      fun y xRef z s => (Real.toNNReal s, S xRef (Φ y xRef s z))
    ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E,
      Measurable (U y xRef z) ∧ Measurable (F y xRef z) ∧
      Measurable (J y xRef z) ∧
      (∀ T : ℝ≥0,
        MeasurableSet (A y xRef z T) ∧
        Measure.map (F y xRef z) (P.restrict (A y xRef z T)) = ρ y xRef z T ∧
        Measure.map (fun sample => J y xRef z (F y xRef z sample))
          (P.restrict (A y xRef z T)) = Measure.map (J y xRef z) (ρ y xRef z T) ∧
        IsFiniteMeasure (ρ y xRef z T) ∧
        (ρ y xRef z T).real Set.univ = 1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z T) ∧
        ρ y xRef z T Set.univ ≤ 1 ∧
        (∀ h : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) → ℝ, Measurable h →
          ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → (∀ a, |h a| ≤ M) →
            Integrable h (Measure.map (J y xRef z) (ρ y xRef z T)) ∧
            Integrable (fun sample => h (J y xRef z (F y xRef z sample)))
              (P.restrict (A y xRef z T)) ∧
            Integrable (fun s => h (J y xRef z s) * d y xRef z s)
              (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ))) ∧
            (∫ sample, h (J y xRef z (F y xRef z sample))
                ∂P.restrict (A y xRef z T)) =
              ∫ s, h (J y xRef z s) * d y xRef z s
                ∂volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ))))

-- Internal FTC ingredient of the sealed finite-density anchor; not the public result.
private theorem first_density_setIntegral
    (l : ℝ → ℝ) (hl : Continuous l) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (∫ s in Set.Ioc 0 t, l s * Real.exp (-(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..s, l u))) =
      1 - Real.exp (-(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..t, l u)) := by
  let L : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..s, l u
  have hL (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt L (l s) s :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hl.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      hl.stronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hl.continuousAt
  have hcL : Continuous L := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hL s).continuousAt
  have hd (s : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt (fun s => 1 - Real.exp (-L s))
        (l s * Real.exp (-L s)) s := by
    simpa only [Pi.neg_apply, mul_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_comm]
      using (hL s).neg.exp.const_sub 1
  have hdC : Continuous (fun s => l s * Real.exp (-L s)) :=
    hl.mul hcL.neg.rexp
  have hf := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le ht
    ((continuous_const.sub hcL.neg.rexp).continuousOn)
    (fun s _ => hd s) (hdC.intervalIntegrable _ _)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht] at hf
  simpa [L] using hf

private theorem first_density_measure_mass
    (l : ℝ → ℝ) (hl : Continuous l) (hn : ∀ s, 0 ≤ l s)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ((volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 t)).withDensity
      (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (l s * Real.exp (-(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..s, l u)))))
        Set.univ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - Real.exp (-(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..t, l u))) := by
  have hL : Continuous (fun s => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..s, l u) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s =>
      (intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hl.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        hl.stronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hl.continuousAt).continuousAt
  have hd : Continuous (fun s => l s * Real.exp (-(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..s, l u))) :=
    hl.mul hL.neg.rexp
  rw [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.restrict_univ,
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal
      ((intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le ht).mp (hd.intervalIntegrable _ _))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => mul_nonneg (hn s) (Real.exp_pos _).le),
    first_density_setIntegral l hl t ht]

private theorem first_density_measure_Iic
    (l : ℝ → ℝ) (hl : Continuous l) (hn : ∀ s, 0 ≤ l s)
    (t a : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    ((volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 t)).withDensity
      (fun s => ENNReal.ofReal (l s * Real.exp (-(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..s, l u)))))
        (Set.Iic a) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - Real.exp (-(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..min t a, l u))) := by
  rw [withDensity_apply _ measurableSet_Iic,
    Measure.restrict_restrict measurableSet_Iic,
    Set.inter_comm (Set.Iic a), Set.Ioc_inter_Iic]
  have hh := first_density_measure_mass l hl hn (min t a) (le_min ht ha)
  simpa only [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.restrict_univ] using hh

private theorem finite_wait_mass
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (U : Ω → WithTop ℝ≥0) (hU : Measurable U) (L : ℝ≥0 → ℝ)
    (hL0 : L 0 = 0)
    (hsurv : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, P.real {sample | (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample} = Real.exp (-L t))
    (t : ℝ≥0) :
    P {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample ∧ U sample ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0)} =
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 - Real.exp (-L t)) := by
  have heq : {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample ∧ U sample ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0)} =
      {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample} \ {sample | (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample} := by
    ext sample
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_sdiff, not_lt]
  have hsub : {sample | (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample} ⊆
      {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample} :=
    fun sample hsample => lt_of_le_of_lt
      (show (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) from
        WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (show (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ t from bot_le)) hsample
  have hz : P.real {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample} = 1 := by
    simpa only [WithTop.coe_zero, hL0, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero] using hsurv 0
  rw [heq, ← ofReal_measureReal,
    measureReal_sdiff hsub (measurableSet_Ioi.preimage hU), hz, hsurv t]

private theorem finite_wait_real_cdf
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (U : Ω → WithTop ℝ≥0) (hU : Measurable U) (L : ℝ≥0 → ℝ)
    (hL0 : L 0 = 0)
    (hsurv : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, P.real {sample | (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample} = Real.exp (-L t))
    (t : ℝ≥0) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (P.restrict {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample ∧ U sample ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0)}).map
      (fun sample => (((U sample).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
      (Set.Iic a) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - Real.exp (-L (min t (Real.toNNReal a)))) := by
  have hF : Measurable (fun sample => (((U sample).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :=
    measurable_subtype_coe.comp (hU.untopD 0)
  rw [Measure.map_apply hF measurableSet_Iic,
    Measure.restrict_apply (measurableSet_Iic.preimage hF)]
  have heq : (fun sample => (((U sample).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) ⁻¹' Set.Iic a ∩
      {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample ∧ U sample ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0)} =
      {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U sample ∧
        U sample ≤ ((min t (Real.toNNReal a) : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)} := by
    ext sample
    cases hh : U sample using WithTop.recTopCoe with
    | top =>
      simp only [hh, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iic, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
      constructor
      · intro hs
        exact (not_le_of_gt (WithTop.coe_lt_top t) hs.2.2).elim
      · intro hs
        exact (not_le_of_gt (WithTop.coe_lt_top (min t (Real.toNNReal a))) hs.2).elim
    | coe s =>
      simp only [hh, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iic,
        Set.mem_ofPred_eq, WithTop.untopD_coe, WithTop.coe_le_coe, le_min_iff,
        Real.le_toNNReal_iff_coe_le ha]
      tauto
  rw [heq]
  exact finite_wait_mass P U hU L hL0 hsurv _

    (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +

    (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /

    Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))

    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)

    fun y xRef z sample => τ y xRef z (ε sample 0)
  let F : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ :=

    fun y xRef z T => {sample | (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < U y xRef z sample ∧

    Measurable (U y xRef z) ∧ Measurable (F y xRef z) ∧
    Measurable (J y xRef z) ∧
    (∀ T : ℝ≥0,

          (∫ sample, h (J y xRef z (F y xRef z sample))
              ∂P.restrict (A y xRef z T)) =

  have hsurv (t : ℝ≥0) :

    hl.mul (hLC.comp continuous_real_toNNReal).neg.rexp
  have hdn (s : ℝ) : 0 ≤ d y xRef z s := mul_nonneg (hn s) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  refine ⟨hUM, hFM, hJM, ?_⟩
  intro T

    (measurableSet_Ioi.preimage hUM).inter (measurableSet_Iic.preimage hUM)
  let D : Measure ℝ := (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 (T : ℝ))).withDensity

  have hρD : ρ y xRef z T = D := by
    apply withDensity_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with s hs
    simp only [d, Λ, Real.coe_toNNReal s hs.1.le, l]

    rw [hmass]

steps.title: Key lemma: integrate the first-event density
steps.text: For any continuous real function l, put L(s)=∫₀ˢl(u)du. The fundamental theorem gives L′=l. The chain rule yields (1−exp(−L))′=l exp(−L). The derivative is continuous, so integrating from0 to t≥0 gives the endpoint difference; L(0)=0 removes the lower endpoint. Nonnegativity is not needed for this identity; the actual nonnegative rate will supply it for the measure.

private theorem first_density_setIntegral
    (l : ℝ → ℝ) (hl : Continuous l) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    (∫ s in Set.Ioc 0 t, l s * Real.exp (-(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..s, l u))) =
      1 - Real.exp (-(∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..t, l u)) := by

  have hL (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt L (l s) s :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hl.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      hl.stronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hl.continuousAt
  have hcL : Continuous L := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun s => (hL s).continuousAt

Map composition identifies U under P with the Exp(1) stopped-clock law, hence P(U>t)=exp(−Λ(t)). Joint continuity of Λ and truncation also give continuous nonnegative d.

steps.title: Identify the actual finite density and its entire measure

For a≥0, the two CDF lemmas agree after converting min(T,toNNReal(a)) to min(T,a). For a<0, F is nonnegative and (0,T] has empty intersection with (−∞,a], so both masses vanish. lesson.lean_statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ satisfy α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix arbitrary y,r∈E and z=(x,p)∈E×E. Define c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_s(z)=(c+cos(s)(x−c)+√η sin(s)p, −sin(s)(x−c)/√η+cos(s)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), and λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}. Total real division makes S_r the identity when g_r(x)=0. For t≥0 set Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ, P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1), ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0}, and U(sample)=τ_z(ε_0(sample)). Thus the authors first threshold is canonical coordinate0, not a supplied clock or law. Set F(sample)=untopD_0(U(sample)), viewed as a real number; it is the finite waiting time when U is finite and zero at infinity. For every finite T≥0 define A_T={sample:0<U(sample)≤T}, d_z(s)=λ_r(Φ_s(z))exp(−Λ_z(max{s,0})), ρ_T=(Lebesgue restricted to (0,T]).withDensity(ofReal(d_z)), and J_z(s)=(max{s,0},S_r(Φ_s(z)))∈[0,∞)×(E×E), for all real s. Then U,F,J_z are Borel measurable. For every finite T, A_T is measurable, F_*(P restricted to A_T)=ρ_T, and (J_z∘F)_*(P restricted to A_T)=(J_z)_*ρ_T. Moreover ρ_T is a finite subprobability measure, ρ_T(ℝ)=1−exp(−Λ_z(T))≤1. For every Borel real h on [0,∞)×(E×E), every M≥0 with |h(a)|≤M for all a, h∈L¹((J_z)_*ρ_T), h∘J_z∘F∈L¹(P restricted to A_T), and s↦h(J_z(s))d_z(s)∈L¹(Lebesgue restricted to (0,T]); their exact integral identity is ∫_(A_T)h(J_z(F(sample)))P(dsample)=∫₀ᵀh(s,S_r(Φ_s(z)))λ_r(Φ_s(z))exp(−Λ_z(s))ds, with the right-hand side understood over (0,T]. All assertions hold for every y,r,z,T, with E,V,α,β,η fixed. Infinity is excluded by A_T before the default finite projection is used; zero thresholds and zero waiting times are excluded by its positive guard and have zero P-mass by the derived survival law at0. The finite-event mass is not renormalized; the missing mass is exp(−Λ_z(T)) and includes waits beyond T and infinite waits. No strict hazard increase, positive rate, almost-sure finite wait, uniform cap, supplied measurability, density or integrability assumption is added. T=0, M=0, rank0, zero normals and flat hazards are included. This is an attributed ASTIS measure-theoretic completion of the actual first-event density factor implicit in the authors AppendixA.1(A.1),(A.2),(A.7), using their actual dynamics and iid clocks. It does not prove the successive conditional factors, full finite-event path expansion, path reversal, invariance, process Markovness, all-L² contraction, mixing, implemented error/cost, actual-input composition or complete main results.
